title: 1913. Maximum Product Difference Between Two Pairs

examples.explanation: We can choose indices 1 and 3 for the first pair (6, 7) and indices 2 and 4 for the second pair (2, 4). The product difference is (6 * 7) - (2 * 4) = 34.
We can choose indices 3 and 6 for the first pair (9, 8) and indices 1 and 5 for the second pair (2, 4). The product difference is (9 * 8) - (2 * 4) = 64.
